posts.title: Framing the Eccentrics
posts.description: A called strike zone, drawn from enough pitches, is not a crisp rectangle. Its edges are soft — there is a band, an inch or two wide, where a taken pitch is sometimes a ball and sometimes a strike — and the softness is not the same on every side. posts.description: The puzzle: the same spot, a different call Take two pitches that cross home plate at the exact same point — same height, same width, low and on the inner edge. posts.title: Four million World Cups before the first whistle
posts.description: The 2026 World Cup kicks off today. I simulated the whole tournament four million times — and unlike most forecasts you’ll read this week, mine tells you how sure it is.
